## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Release

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Docker smoke test, if runtime/deployment behavior changed
- [ ] React Doctor, if frontend behavior changed

## Notes

Call out migration, release, security, or compatibility concerns.
